nonClaims: A nomenclatural catalog match does not verify the guide's specimen identification or any particular catch event.
The survey period 2014-2018 is not an exact date for any source-reported species row.
Two families differ from the frozen matching service: preserve both classifications and do not silently rewrite the frozen taxonomy snapshot.
No current presence, wild establishment, abundance, exact capture point, fishing permission, diet, bait, safety, or complete Taal list is inferred.
No source text, photographs, or page images are copied into Bangwit.
All 45 NFRDI guide rows remain outside the public app projection pending source-identification and noncommercial publication-scope review.
